name: school-automation-overhaul
goal: Build the complete new school-automation layer (district / school-by-grade-band / kid) as additive files that run alongside the existing system, so it can be shadow-run for a full school week before anything live is removed. Track A only: everything achievable in a worktree with no live Home Assistant instance and no human in the loop.

userStories.title: Take deploy.sh out of the secrets business
userStories.description: Remove every line where deploy.sh writes to or deletes secrets.yaml, and make the Docker-missing validation branch fail loudly instead of silently skipping. Ships as its own commit, before all other work.
acceptanceCriteria: cp secrets.fake.yaml secrets.yaml (~line 60), the rm -f secrets.yaml in the check_config failure branch (~line 66), and the trailing rm -f secrets.yaml (~line 68) are all removed
grep -n 'secrets.yaml' deploy.sh shows only read-only or comment references
The Docker-missing branch (~line 56) exits non-zero instead of warning and continuing
A comment above check_config states secrets.yaml is human-managed and no script may modify it
The secrets.fake.yaml retain-or-retire decision is recorded in working-memory.md Decision Ledger
Lands as its own commit, separate from every other task

userStories.title: Delete google_calendars.yaml
userStories.description: Dead legacy config for a Google integration format HA no longer reads, and the repo's largest privacy exposure (contains Gianluca's Google calendar ID).
acceptanceCriteria: google_calendars.yaml is deleted
grep -rn 'google_calendars' . excluding plans/ returns no hits
configuration.yaml is confirmed to contain no google: block before deleting

userStories.title: Delete dead files with no live consumer
userStories.description: Remove nine dead files plus the legacy Nino Pickup automation. Phantom-check each before deletion.
acceptanceCriteria: Eight of the nine listed files are deleted. district_late_start_wednesday_boolean.yaml is DEFERRED TO TRACK C — it defines input_boolean.district_late_start_wednesday, which has three live consumers (primary_school_day_on.yaml:47, primary_school_day_off.yaml:34, school_day_reminder.yaml:39). The PRD wrongly listed it as consumer-free; deleting it would break the old system during the shadow-run week.
templates/speech/briefing.yaml is deleted in full, not just the pickup_nino() macro whose call site is at line 57; templates/ confirmed unreferenced in configuration.yaml
The Nino Pickup block (id 1646884521741) is removed from automations.yaml and the file still parses
For each deletion, a grep confirms no remaining consumer outside plans/
Nothing deleted here is read by packages/reminders/morning_update.yaml

userStories.title: Build school_year.yaml
userStories.description: Year-bound input_datetime helpers plus the derived binary_sensor.school_year_active.
acceptanceCriteria: Declares input_datetime.school_year_first_day and school_year_last_day, has_date true, has_time false
Neither carries initial: — it disables state restoration and silently reverts dashboard edits on restart. Real dates (2026-08-20, 2027-05-27) in a header comment only
binary_sensor.school_year_active is true when today falls within the two dates inclusive, with an availability: guard when either input is unset
Header comment records Glenbrook South as out of scope (District 225)
Modern syntax throughout: triggers/conditions/actions, trigger:/action: keys

userStories.title: Override booleans and their ungated nightly reset
userStories.description: The only manual controls in a derived system, plus the reset that stops them latching forever.
acceptanceCriteria: school_overrides.yaml declares input_boolean.school_day_override_off and early_dismissal_today, neither with initial:
school_overrides_reset.yaml has one automation at 23:58:00 turning both off
The reset has NO conditions: block at all — a gated reset is how the birthday-countdown flags latched forever
The reset is in its own file, not buried in school_overrides.yaml
Header comment explains why the reset is ungated, citing the prior latch failure

userStories.title: Calendar sensors — one template block per calendar
userStories.description: Three independent trigger-based template files. Separate files because a response-returning service resolving to zero entities raises and would kill every sensor in a shared block.
acceptanceCriteria: Three separate files: district_calendar_sensors.yaml, primary_school_calendar_sensors.yaml, parochial_school_calendar_sensors.yaml
Each has three triggers: time_pattern hours: /1, homeassistant start, and event_template_reloaded. Never hours: 1 (fires once daily at 01:00)
Every calendar.get_events call has continue_on_error: true and every response var is dereferenced with | default({})
Responses iterated as .values() | map(attribute='events') | sum(start=[]) — no calendar entity ID inside Jinja
Entity IDs inline in target: blocks, each marked with a # TODO(track-b) comment for the !secret migration
Day matching is by OVERLAP not start-date equality: all-day uses start[:10] <= day and day < end[:10]; timed uses start[:10] <= day <= end[:10]; all-day detected via start|length == 10
Closure test is 'no school' in summary|lower; the 'District Closed' clause is NOT carried over

Grade-scope guard rejects grade[s]?\s*[K0-9], \d(st|nd|rd|th)\s+grade, and word-scopes kindergarten/preschool/EC unless the summary names JK or junior kindergarten; unrecognized scoped closures fail OPEN into Tier 2
Tier 1 is tested BEFORE the athletics filter
Athletics filter matches ' - Practice' / ' - Game'
Events deduped on (summary, start)
Emits binary_sensor.<scope>_closed_today/_tomorrow and sensor.<scope>_events_today/_tomorrow
Event payloads in attributes; state: is now().isoformat() (255-char state limit)
No unique_id collides with the still-live primary_school_closed or primary_school_closed_tomorrow

userStories.title: The three D34 grade-band schedules
userStories.description: primary (K-2), intermediate (3-5), middle (6-8). No high-school file.
acceptanceCriteria: Each declares <band>_school_start_time, _late_start_time, _dismissal_time — none with initial:; real times in header comments (primary 8:45/9:45/15:40, intermediate 7:45/8:45/14:40, middle 8:15/9:15/15:10)
Each defines sensor.<band>_school_start_time_today and _dismissal_time_today with device_class: timestamp

Timestamps built as today_at('00:00') + timedelta(seconds=state_attr(...,'timestamp')), never as_datetime() on a concatenated string — a naive value makes SensorEntity.state raise and errors the entity
Each timestamp sensor has an availability: template rather than an empty state render
Each defines binary_sensor.<band>_school_late_start_today/_late_start_tomorrow/_in_session_today/_in_session_tomorrow
Late start is derived (weekday == 2 and in_session), never latched
in_session requires school-year-active AND weekday AND not closed AND school_day_override_off is off
No Glenbrook South / high-school file is created

userStories.title: Parochial (Junior Kindergarten) schedule
userStories.description: Start time, fixed departure, and five per-weekday dismissal inputs.
acceptanceCriteria: Declares parochial_school_start_time, parochial_school_departure_time, and five per-weekday dismissals — none with initial:; header comment records 8:05 start, 7:45 departure, Mon 14:20 / Tue 12:20 / Wed 14:20 / Thu 12:20 / Fri 12:20
Departure is an absolute input, not a lead-minutes subtraction
sensor.parochial_school_dismissal_time_today selects by weekday, device_class: timestamp, same construction and availability rules as task 7
binary_sensor.parochial_school_in_session_today requires a 'Gianluca School' event AND no 'no school' marker AND the override off
Entity IDs use parochial_school_*; only friendly names say Junior Kindergarten

userStories.title: The kid layer
userStories.description: Map Nino to primary and Gianluca to parochial, deriving school-day, departure and pickup per kid.
acceptanceCriteria: Filename uniqueness verified first: find packages -name 'nino_school.yaml' -o -name 'gianluca_school.yaml' returns only these two — !include_dir_named keys by basename globally and collisions are silent
The kid-to-band mapping is a single referenced entity per kid, so a band change is a one-line edit
Each defines binary_sensor.<kid>_school_day, sensor.<kid>_departure_time, sensor.<kid>_pickup_time (latter two device_class: timestamp, built and gated per task 7 rules)
Nino gets nino_departure_lead_minutes and nino_pickup_lead_minutes; Gianluca gets gianluca_pickup_lead_minutes only — his departure reads the fixed input from task 8
No initial: on any input_number; defaults (25/20/20) in header comments
Every <kid>_school_day sensor honours input_boolean.school_day_override_off
No unique_id overlaps the still-live input_boolean.nino_school_day / gianluca_school_day

userStories.title: Morning reminder
userStories.description: Household breakfast nudge, late-start aware, reading the new derived sensors.
acceptanceCriteria: Declares input_datetime.school_breakfast_reminder_time (no initial:) and one automation triggering on it
Conditions: house_occupied on, and either kid's new binary_sensor.<kid>_school_day on
Calls script.voice_announcement with media_players: auto, sound school-bell-chime, preserving the random-line style and the both-kids / Nino-only / Gianluca-only branches
The late-start branch reads binary_sensor.primary_school_late_start_today, not the old input_boolean
Does not duplicate gating already inside script.voice_announcement

userStories.title: Per-kid departure reminders
userStories.description: Split the single shared reminder into two, routed to the parent doing each drop-off. Push-only for week one.
acceptanceCriteria: Each triggers via trigger: time / at: sensor.<kid>_departure_time
Nino's pushes to devices: jk; Gianluca's to devices: cfalb
Both ship push-only: script.general_notification only, with the script.voice_announcement call present but COMMENTED OUT
Header comment states enabling TTS is an explicit decision after one week, not a scheduled un-suppression — this turns one daily announcement into two 35 min apart
Each conditions on the corresponding binary_sensor.<kid>_school_day
Each carries a comment noting the trigger only schedules when the sensor time is in the future, so a mid-morning reload can silently skip the day

userStories.title: Per-kid pickup reminders
userStories.description: Rebuild both pickups against the new timestamp sensors with consistent notification plumbing.
acceptanceCriteria: Each triggers via trigger: time / at: sensor.<kid>_pickup_time
Both use script.general_notification; Gianluca's raw notify.ios_family call is not carried over
Pushes route to the parent doing that pickup
The tag typo nino_school_pikcup is corrected to nino_school_pickup
New files live under packages/school/reminders/ and their basenames do not collide with the still-live originals

userStories.title: Evening announcements
userStories.description: Closed-tomorrow and late-start-tomorrow heads-ups, consuming the _tomorrow sensors.
acceptanceCriteria: Each fires in the evening off the _tomorrow sensors from tasks 6 and 7
Both call script.voice_announcement and condition on input_boolean.house_occupied
Late-start-tomorrow reads binary_sensor.primary_school_late_start_tomorrow
No school_notable_event_tomorrow_reminder is created

userStories.title: Re-point morning_update.yaml
userStories.description: Move the three school reads onto the new sensors, harden them, and fix the phantom calendar target.
acceptanceCriteria: Lines 114, 116, 150 read the new sensors and are converted from states.<domain>.<object>.state to is_state(), so a missing entity degrades instead of raising UndefinedError and killing the whole prompt render
Line 248's phantom calendar.ninos_school target is removed from the calendar_events_today get_events call

The calendar_events_today target list is otherwise unchanged, with a comment at ~line 247 stating calendar.olph_school and calendar.gianluca_school must not be added there because that aggregation is not tier-filtered
The Tier 2 informational list is added to the prompt, capped at 5 entries
After this task morning_update.yaml references no entity that Track C will delete

userStories.title: School dashboard view
userStories.description: Build the missing view and wire it into kohbo.yaml. It is the sole editing surface for every schedule input.
acceptanceCriteria: New view at path 'school', included in dashboards/kohbo/kohbo.yaml, resolving the dead link at dashboards/templates/includes/navbar.yaml:73
Card conventions match an existing view — read dashboards/kohbo/climate/climate.yaml or a room view first and follow its structure and template usage

Sections: Today (per-kid state, leave/start/pickup times, late-start badge, closures, both override toggles), Schools (per-band pickers), Junior Kindergarten (start, departure, five dismissals), Calendar, Lunch
Every schedule input_datetime from tasks 4, 7, 8 is editable from this view — YAML-declared helpers are editable: false and never appear in Settings > Helpers
Header comment warns the Yellow's kohbo.yaml must be verified against this repo before deploying (host git divergence would make this a clobber)

userStories.title: Static validation
userStories.description: Everything verifiable without a live Home Assistant instance.
acceptanceCriteria: ha core check (or ./deploy.sh --check with Docker confirmed running) passes
find packages -name '*.yaml' | xargs -n1 basename | sort | uniq -d returns nothing
No new file uses a .yml extension
No legacy syntax in newly created files under packages/school/
grep -rn 'initial:' packages/school/ returns nothing
grep -rn 'hours: 1$' packages/school/ returns nothing
Every new trigger-based template contains event_template_reloaded
